implementation: Configuration save remains separate from restart. Busy tasks require one explicit interruption confirmation. No waiting/restart queue.

saved.message: 已保存，重启搭子后生效。

busy.message: 重启搭子会中断当前任务，是否继续？

restart.initial_request: force=false; busy returns confirmation_required without quitting
restart.confirmed_request: force=true; rechecks current identity and status, permits interruption of busy tasks
restart.unknown: manual restart; never quit unidentified processes
restart.termination: Normal AppKit termination request; wait for complete exit before opening. No force-kill signals.
restart.configuration: unchanged by restart, cancellation, failure or popup dismissal
restart.compatibility: macOS DuMate 1.0.89.447 personal local engine; otherwise manual restart

scenarios: Initial save and cancellation both offer explicit restart.
Busy check never implicitly forces restart.
Cancel and Escape do not send force=true.
Logout or dismissal prevents a late confirmation.
Explicit force allows busy tasks to be interrupted.
Unknown state, quit refusal or incomplete exit never opens a replacement instance.

boundaries: Native quit script unchanged from prior fixture verification.
Real user DuMate was not restarted or interrupted in this verification.
